gaps.lead: 'Have you finished the report?' the manager asked her.
gaps.explanation: Yes/no questions are reported with if/whether + statement word order.

gaps.lead: 'I've never been to Asia,' she told me.
gaps.sentence: She told me that ___ to Asia.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect shifts to past perfect: she had never been.

gaps.lead: The tickets were so expensive that we didn't buy any.
gaps.sentence: They were ___ that we didn't buy any.
gaps.explanation: so expensive (tickets) → such expensive tickets (no article with plural).

gaps.lead: People claim that this juice cures colds.
I got used to night shifts after a month.
gaps.sentence: After a month, I ___ night shifts.
gaps.explanation: After a period: be used to (state) or had got used to (achievement).

gaps.lead: The film was so long that we missed the last bus.
gaps.sentence: It was ___ that we missed the last bus.
gaps.explanation: so long (a film) → such a long film.
